title: Yummy Buttery American Chicken Casserole
description: A buttery and juicy American dish featuring chicken, tarragon, and French flavors, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the chicken with flour to coat.
In a large skillet, melt 1/4 cup of butter over medium heat and cook the chicken until browned.
In a separate saucepan, combine the chicken broth, heavy cream, tarragon, salt, and pepper, and bring to a simmer.
Stir the cooked chicken into the saucepan and cook until the sauce thickens.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of the chicken mixture.
Top the chicken with a layer of frozen peas and carrots.
Sprinkle the crushed French fried onions over the top of the casserole.
Drizzle the remaining 1/4 cup of melted butter over the onions.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
